details:
Allow the importing of any common image format (png, jpeg, the works) into an instance to be viewed by nearby users. The image would exist in the space, able to be scaled, moved, and removed by any nearby user that is within interacting range. The potential is endless. Shitposting inside VRChat would be possible, 3d stereoscopic shitposting.

this should NEVER be allowed in (group) public instances and disabled by default in all other instance types per-user. Here's some settings that would be good.

Default option: Disabled across all instances. Disabled for friends, disabled in invite+ worlds, you can't even send pictures. Images show as grey rectangles that match the picture's aspect ratio with a big ol' VRChat logo in the middle like the back of a personal mirror.

2nd option: Manually download and show images, the image is shown when downloaded but not downloaded when not shown. (sub-setting: show and download images as blurred automatically and manually choose to show?)

3rd option: Download and display all images sent by friends

Images could be sent peer to peer? I dunno if that's possible, I don't understand networking at all and I don't know what VRChat has going on in that department. If it must be sent through the VRChat servers, a file size limit (that gets larger with VRChat+ :P) should be fine????????????

Images should be put through some sort of filter to make sure nothing sensitive or graphic is being sent to other users, and when something is flagged, both sender and image recipient are aggressively asked if they're okay with sending/receiving a possibly sensitive image (apple's imessage implements this well). Even if just between friends, a lot of bad things happen online, and having a user added as a "friend" doesn't really mean anything. 

My fellow VRChat users, do you think this is a good idea? Please discuss in the comments of this post. I think the potential here is great but there's a lot of bad actors that could fuck it up for everyone.
title: Sharing images to an instance to be viewed by other players in the same instance.
